source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-maincb-error-improvement — Complete error improvement: there are universal epsilon_max^cb>0, delta_max^cb>0 and c_0^cb<infinity such that every extended delta-inclusion v:B->A from a finite-dimensional C*-algebra B into an extended epsilon-C*-algebra A with 0<=epsilon<=epsilon_max^cb and 0<=delta<=delta_max^cb can be replaced by an extended c_0^cb*epsilon-inclusion v_tilde:B->A that is bijective whenever v is bijective.
